title: Stoichiometric O\(_2\) Demand from Reduced-Pool Inventories — rri_o2_demand
text: Interpretation — 25-fold contrast. mechanistic review (Ghotbi et al., 2026) provides worked example: Fe-rich rhizosphere containing 50 mmol Fe(II) kg\(^{-1}\), 5 mmol FeS kg\(^{-1}\), 2 mmol Mn(II) kg\(^{-1}\), 2 mmol NH\(_4^+\) kg\(^{-1}\), 2 mmol acetate kg\(^{-1}\), 0.5 mmol CH\(_4\) kg\(^{-1}\) complete-oxidation O\(_2\) ceiling \(\approx 34\) mmol O\(_2\) kg\(^{-1}\), versus \(\approx 1.3\) mmol O\(_2\) kg\(^{-1}\) illustrative initial pore-gas stock: 26-fold contrast. assumed stock air-saturated porewater. Continuing atmospheric root O2 delivery can replenish . Accessibility, reaction kinetics transport determine realized demand event. Pyrite stoichiometry. Complete pyrite oxidation sulfate Fe(III) oxyhydroxide releases 4 mol H\(^+\) mol\(^{-1}\) FeS\(_2\) consumes 3.75 mol O\(_2\): FeS\(_2\) + 15/4 O\(_2\) + 7/2 H\(_2\)O → Fe(OH)\(_3\) + 2H\(_2\)\(_4\). Partial oxidation sulfur intermediates (S\(^0\), thiosulfate) requires fewer moles; adjust via custom_coefs. pH coupling. applicable rate law, homogeneous abiotic Fe(II) oxidation increases \(\approx\)100-fold per unit pH rise (Stumm & Lee, 1961; Millero et al., 1987). stoichiometric demand computed complete oxidation independent pH, actual O\(_2\) consumption rates pH-modulated. function reports stoichiometric potential demand, thermodynamic limit rate.
